## Premise withdrawn — recommend closing `not_a_bug`

This ticket was filed by me during the debug of `conversant-cepivorous-mastiff` on the premise
that `claim` had been widened to accept a `blocked` source status. **That widening was
reverted** (operator ruling; it was creation of capability, not restoration — `blocked` is
designed to be unclaimable, per `AGENTS.md:129-131`).

Without the widening there is no claim on a `blocked -> in_progress` edge, so the gap this
ticket describes does not exist. The remaining narrow keying is **documented intended
behaviour**, not an omission — `reducer/_processors_status.py::_fold_claimed_session`:

> "Keyed on the ``open -> in_progress`` edge only, so a later ``blocked -> in_progress`` (etc.)
> leaves it untouched."

It does not survive independently of the withdrawn premise. Recommend closing `not_a_bug`.
